name: 07726 · Manalapan, NJ
findings: ZIP 07726 (Manalapan) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07726 (Manalapan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07726 (Manalapan) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
